title: 微软前任 CEO 如何向员工介绍接班人（2014）
topic: 微软前任 CEO 如何向员工介绍接班人（2014）

source.title: Steve Ballmer email to employees on new CEO - Source
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: From: Steve Ballmer To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is an incredibly exciting day as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft. Satya will be a great CEO, and I am pumped for the future of Microsoft. You can read the full announcement here.

Satya is a proven leader. He’s got strong technical skills and great business insights. He has a remarkable ability to see what’s going on in the market, to sense opportunity, and to really understand how we come together at Microsoft to execute against those opportunities in a collaborative way. I have worked closely with Satya for many years and I have seen these skills many times. He is not alone, though. Our Senior Leadership Team has never been stronger, and together this group will drive us forward.

Microsoft is one of the great companies in the world. I love this company. I love the bigness and boldness of what we do. I love the way we partner with other companies to come together to change the world. I love the breadth and the diversity of all of the customers we empower, from students in the classroom to consumers to small businesses to governments to the largest enterprises.
translations: 发件人：史蒂夫·鲍尔默 收件人：全体员工 日期：2014年2月4日 主题：萨提亚·纳德拉——微软新任首席执行官
今天是一个令人无比兴奋的日子，我们宣布萨提亚·纳德拉担任微软新任首席执行官。萨提亚将成为一位出色的首席执行官，我对微软的未来充满热情。您可以在此处阅读完整的公告。
萨提亚是一位经验证明出色的领导者。他技术功底扎实，也有敏锐的商业洞察力。他善于洞察市场动态、捕捉机会，也真正理解微软团队如何协作，把握并推进这些机会。我与萨提亚共事多年，亲眼见过他多次展现这些能力。当然，他并非独自承担重任；我们的高级领导团队空前强大，大家会共同推动公司向前发展。
微软是世界上最优秀的公司之一。我热爱这家公司，也热爱我们所做事业的规模与魄力。我热爱我们与其他公司携手改变世界的方式，也热爱我们所服务的客户群体广泛而多元：从课堂里的学生、普通消费者、小型企业和政府，到大型企业。
fullTextParagraphs: From: Steve Ballmer To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is an incredibly exciting day as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft. Satya will be a great CEO, and I am pumped for the future of Microsoft. You can read the full announcement here.

Satya is a proven leader. He’s got strong technical skills and great business insights. He has a remarkable ability to see what’s going on in the market, to sense opportunity, and to really understand how we come together at Microsoft to execute against those opportunities in a collaborative way. I have worked closely with Satya for many years and I have seen these skills many times. He is not alone, though. Our Senior Leadership Team has never been stronger, and together this group will drive us forward.

Microsoft is one of the great companies in the world. I love this company. I love the bigness and boldness of what we do. I love the way we partner with other companies to come together to change the world. I love the breadth and the diversity of all of the customers we empower, from students in the classroom to consumers to small businesses to governments to the largest enterprises.
Above all, I love the spirit of this place, the passion, and the perseverance, which has been the cornerstone of our culture from the very beginning.
Stay focused and keep moving forward. I am excited about what we will do. Satya’s appointment confirms that.
Thanks for making Microsoft the most amazing place to work on the planet, and thanks for the chance to lead.

notes.phrase: From: Steve Ballmer To: All Employees
notes.meaning: 邮件格式：发件人、收件人、日期和主题
notes.explain: 这是正式商务邮件的标准格式，清晰标明了邮件的来源、接收者、发送日期和核心主题
notes.example: From: HR Department To: New Hires Date: June 15, 2023 Subject: Welcome to Our Company

notes.phrase: I am pumped for the future of Microsoft
notes.meaning: 我对微软的未来充满热情和期待
notes.explain: pump 在这里作动词，表示"使充满热情、兴奋"，是一种非正式但表达强烈情感的方式
notes.example: After the successful product launch, the team is pumped for the next quarter's challenges

notes.phrase: strong technical skills and great business
notes.meaning: 他具有非凡的市场洞察能力
notes.explain: remarkable 表示"非凡的、引人注目的"，强调这种能力的突出和与众不同
notes.example: Her remarkable ability to anticipate market trends has made her a valuable asset to the company

notes.phrase: I love the breadth and the diversity of all of the customers we empower
notes.meaning: 我热爱我们所赋能的各类客户的广泛性和多样性
notes.explain: breadth 指范围广度，diversity 指多样性，empower 表示"赋能"，体现了微软对各类客户的支持
notes.example: Our company prides itself on the breadth and diversity of solutions we provide to different industries

scenario.title: Summarize how Ballmer introduced his successor
english: A colleague asks how Steve Ballmer described Satya Nadella when announcing him as Microsoft’s new CEO in 2014.
You highlight Nadella’s technical and business strengths, his understanding of the market, and his ability to bring teams together to pursue opportunities.
Your answer stays close to Ballmer’s original message rather than inventing concerns about the transition.
chinese: 一位同事问，Steve Ballmer 在 2014 年宣布 Satya Nadella 接任微软 CEO 时如何介绍他。
你概括 Nadella 的技术和商业能力、对市场的理解，以及推动团队协作抓住机会的能力。
回答贴近 Ballmer 的原始邮件，不添加交接中的虚构担忧。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事问 Steve Ballmer 在 2014 年宣布 Satya Nadella 接任 CEO 时，怎样介绍他的能力并表达对交接的态度。请用英文概括。
firstAttempt.sample: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven leader with strong technical skills and business insight. He said Nadella understood the market and how Microsoft teams could work together to act on opportunities.
firstAttempt.rationale: 回答概括原邮件对 Nadella 的评价和协作方式，不加入原文没有的项目变更或担忧。

words.meaning: 令人兴奋的，激动人心的
words.example: The CEO announced some exciting new initiatives for the upcoming fiscal year.
words.translation: CEO宣布了一些令人兴奋的新举措，即将到来的财政年度。
words.note: 用于描述能引起强烈兴趣和积极情绪的事物，常用于商业场合表达乐观态度

words.collocation: proven track record, proven ability, proven method
words.example: She has a proven track record of delivering projects on time and under budget.
words.translation: 她有着按时并在预算内完成项目的可靠记录。
words.note: 强调某事物已被实践检验并证明有效，常用于描述领导者、方法或产品的可靠性

words.collocation: gain insights, provide insights, valuable insights
words.example: The market research report provided valuable insights into consumer behavior.
words.translation: 这份市场研究报告提供了关于消费者行为的宝贵见解。
words.note: 指对事物本质的深刻理解和独到观点，在商业环境中尤为重要

words.collocation: collaborative approach, collaborative effort, collaborative environment
words.example: Our company fosters a collaborative environment where ideas can be shared freely.
words.translation: 我们公司培养了一种协作环境，可以自由分享想法。
words.note: 强调团队合作和共同工作的重要性，现代企业文化中的核心价值观

words.collocation: show boldness, act with boldness, strategic boldness
words.example: The CEO's bold decision to enter a new market has paid off significantly.
words.translation: CEO大胆进入新市场的决策已经取得了显著回报。
words.note: 描述敢于冒险、勇于创新的态度，在商业领导力中是重要品质

words.collocation: empower employees, empower customers, empower communities
words.example: Our mission is to empower small businesses with the technology they need to compete.
words.translation: 我们的使命是赋予小企业所需的科技能力，使他们能够竞争。
words.note: 现代商业术语，指提供工具、资源或权力使某人能够更有效地行动或实现目标

structure.original: Today is an incredibly exciting day as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft.
analysis: Today is an incredibly exciting day - 这是一个主系表结构，'Today'作为主语，'is'作为系动词，'an incredibly exciting day'作为表语，其中'incredibly'是副词修饰形容词'exciting'
as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft - 这是一个时间状语从句，由连词'as'引导，表示'正当此时'，从句中包含一个主谓宾结构'we announce Satya Nadella'和一个介词短语'as the new CEO of Microsoft'作为宾语补足语
整个句子由主句和从句构成，通过'as'连接，表示因果关系或时间关系，从句解释了为什么今天是一个令人兴奋的日子
structure.transfer: Today marks an important step as we welcome our new project lead.

rewrite.bad: We should announce the new CEO without explaining his experience or how the handoff will work.
rewrite.good: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven leader with strong technical skills and business insight. He said Nadella understood the market and how Microsoft teams could work together to act on opportunities.
rewrite.translation: 鲍尔默称纳德拉是一位经验丰富的领导者，具备扎实的技术能力和商业洞察力。他表示，纳德拉了解市场，也懂得如何让微软团队协作抓住机会。
rewrite.pattern: Ballmer described [the successor] as [strengths] and expressed confidence in [the transition].

cloze.prompt: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven ___.
cloze.why: a proven leader 表示已有实际表现证明其领导能力。

cloze.prompt: Nadella had strong technical skills and business ___.
cloze.why: business insight 表示对业务和市场的理解。

cloze.prompt: I’m looking forward to seeing how he brings the team ___ around new opportunities.
cloze.why: bring a team together 表示凝聚团队共同工作。

dictation.text: The team members express concerns about Mark's different management style and worry about potential changes in their established workflows and project priorities.
Sarah addresses the concerns by highlighting Mark's relevant experience and facilitating a team discussion where Mark shares his vision while also listening to team members' perspectives.

translationPractice.prompt: Ballmer 将 Nadella 描述为一位经得起验证的领导者。
translationPractice.answer: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven leader.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“a proven leader”在介绍有实际业绩证明的负责人时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: Ballmer 表示，Nadella 具备出色的技术能力和商业洞察力。
translationPractice.answer: Ballmer said Nadella had strong technical skills and great business insight.
translationPractice.why: strong technical skills 和 business insight 是 Ballmer 在邮件中对 Nadella 的评价。

choice.prompt: 同事问 Steve Ballmer 在 2014 年宣布 Satya Nadella 接任 CEO 时，怎样介绍他的能力并表达对交接的态度。请用英文概括。
options: Ballmer introduced Satya Nadella as the new CEO and praised his technical skills, business insight, and ability to help teams act on opportunities.

Ballmer described Nadella as a proven leader with strong technical skills and business insight. He said Nadella understood the market and how Microsoft teams could work together to act on opportunities.
Ballmer said the leadership team lacked the experience to guide Microsoft through the transition.
choice.why: 回答概括原邮件对 Nadella 的评价和协作方式，不加入原文没有的项目变更或担忧。

output.prompt: 你要向团队介绍一位新项目负责人。请用两句英文概括对方的专业背景和协作优势，并表达你对合作的期待。
output.sample: The new project lead brings strong technical skills and business insight. I’m looking forward to seeing how they bring the team together around new opportunities.
check: 是否介绍了具体的专业优势？
是否说明了对团队协作的期待？
是否把模拟介绍与 Ballmer 对 Nadella 的原话区分开？
